about.title: About
about.changelogText:
v0.2.0 Changelog:

🤖 AI Assistant
• In-chat LLM provider and model switching
• Agent backend split into Local DB, NexusMods, and LoversLab search tools, plus result merge, rerank, and answer generation modules
• Schema-aware query planner with enum slot options to reduce hallucinated queries
• Game alias system maps localized and common names to canonical game names
• Semantic reranker supports LLM cross-encoder style relevance scoring
• Added adult content detection, multi-sort, and SQL injection validation

📡 LoversLab Crawling
• LoversLab rules now support RSS, page scraping, and combined RSS + page mode
• Supports multiple Feed URLs, page URLs, and persistent browser profiles
• Added browser helpers: browser check, Chromium install, login opening, session check, category test, and snapshot saving
• RSS fetching now uses streaming download with Content-Length pre-check and a 5MB size guard
• Added Cloudflare detection, system proxy auto-discovery, HTML sanitization, and stable IDs (SHA256 fallback)
• Forum topic RSS can extract real file URLs; results are deduplicated and time-sorted

🔎 Discover And Rules
• Discover page now supports card/list view switching
• Added hide, ignored-list, and restore flows for mods
• Added filters and sorting for source, game, adult content policy, updated time, first seen time, downloads, likes, and endorsements
• Mod cards show richer stats and provide summary/introduction generation actions
• Rules support import/export, with test and save using the same data source
• NexusMods rules add category names, tags, and sort configuration
• Rule notifications support instant, daily digest, and weekly digest modes

📊 Reports And Jobs
• Added LLM summary reports in Chinese, English, and Japanese
• Added manual report runs plus daily/weekly digest generation
• Startup catch-up handles missed periods, with provider-chain fallback
• Dashboard adds job status, recent job runs, and scheduler pause/resume controls

🔔 Notification Center
• Added sidebar notification center for sent notification history
• Supports mark read, mark all read, and real-time unread counts
• Update events support read/unread filtering
• Reduced noisy background job events

⚙️ Settings And Providers
• LLM settings now use a prioritized multi-provider chain with automatic fallback
• Built-in providers: Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, xAI, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax
• Added LLM provider tests, proxy settings, settings import/export
• Added Windows auto-start configuration

🔐 Security
• Fixed threading.Lock → asyncio.Lock to avoid blocking the async event loop
• API keys are no longer persisted in plaintext from environment variables
• Admin Token auth moved to httpOnly cookies, with silent localStorage migration
• SSRF protection adds DNS rebinding detection with pre/post request IP fingerprinting
• Outbound LLM URLs block private/loopback addresses for non-local providers

🛠 Startup And Release
• Backend can serve the frontend static build for single-app local deployment
• Startup scripts improve Python/Node detection and add Node 24 LTS priority
• Release packages include frontend/dist; normal users can run start-user.bat after extraction

rules.nexusmods.gameDomainNameHelp: The game domain from the Nexus Mods URL, for example skyrimspecialedition in https://www.nexusmods.com/games/skyrimspecialedition.
rules.nexusmods.updatedSinceDaysHelp: Limits mods updated or created within this many days. In All mode, it is kept in the rule config only.
rules.nexusmods.queryModeHelp: Filter by update time, creation time, or query all results for this game.
rules.nexusmods.sortByHelp: Controls the result order requested from Nexus Mods.
rules.nexusmods.categoryNamesPlaceholder: Type a category and press Enter
rules.nexusmods.categoryNamesHelp: Add one or more Nexus category names. Type one value and press Enter; commas are kept as part of the name.
rules.nexusmods.tagsHelp: Add one or more Nexus tags. Type one value and press Enter; commas are kept as part of the tag.
rules.nexusmods.tagsPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter
rules.nexusmods.errors.updatedSinceDaysN: Days must be a valid number
rules.loverslab.feedUrlsPlaceholder: One RSS feed URL per line
rules.loverslab.feedUrlsHelp: Only loverslab.com RSS URLs are supported.
rules.loverslab.pageUrlsHelp: For page mode, use category URLs like https://www.loverslab.com/files/category/xxx . Example: https://www.loverslab.com/files/category/161-the-sims-4/
rules.loverslab.ruleGuideLine1: RSS remains available for public updates. Category page mode prefers your installed Chrome/Edge and fetches HTML with an isolated app profile.
rules.loverslab.ruleGuideLine2: RSS URLs must use the loverslab.com or www.loverslab.com domain.
rules.loverslab.ruleGuideLine3: Updated Since (Days) is the source window. Common updated-days filter is applied again after that.
rules.loverslab.ruleGuideLine4: Game Tag should be the board/list name you track, such as Skyrim SE or Fallout 4.
rules.loverslab.ruleGuideLine5: Open a target board page first (for example https://www.loverslab.com/forum/34-skyrim-non-adult-mods/). At the bottom, click the "Available RSS feeds" button, then copy the resulting feed URL. Enter one URL per line.
rules.loverslab.updatedSinceDaysHelp: This is the RSS parsing window. The common "Updated Within Days" filter is applied afterwards.
rules.loverslab.pageUpdatedSinceDaysHelp: This is the source-side window for page results. The common "Updated Within Days" filter is applied afterwards.
rules.loverslab.maxItemsPerRunHelp: Limits how many items one discovery run can return. RSS and category page results both use this cap.
rules.loverslab.rssNotice: RSS mode often lacks download/like metrics. If you enable metric thresholds, set missing metrics policy to pass. sourceConfig.updatedSinceDays and common updated-days filter use the stricter intersection.
rules.loverslab.rssModeHelp: RSS mode does not need a login browser or isolated Profile. If human verification cannot be completed, keep RSS mode and enter RSS feed URLs.
rules.loverslab.pageModeHelp: Page scraping is an experimental optional enhancement. It uses the login browser and isolated Profile, but human verification, site risk controls, or page structure changes can still make scraping fail. Switch back to RSS if it fails.
rules.loverslab.browserProfileHelp: The app prefers an installed Chrome/Edge binary and uses its own isolated Profile. If human verification appears, finish it in the opened browser window, then click Check Session. Verification is not guaranteed to pass, and page scraping can still fail. It does not read your everyday browser cookies/profile.
rules.loverslab.structureChangedHelp: The page is reachable, but no file items were parsed. Save an HTML Snapshot and check whether selectors need an update.
rules.loverslab.browserTestMissingUrl: Enter a category page URL first.
rules.filters.keywordFilterHelp: Filter by keywords found in text such as titles and descriptions. Type one keyword and press Enter to add it.
rules.filters.includeKeywordsHelp: When set, a result must match at least one included keyword. Leave empty to skip this rule.
rules.filters.excludeKeywordsHelp: Results matching any excluded keyword are filtered out.
rules.filters.metricsHelp: Set minimum thresholds for downloads, endorsements, likes, and updated time. Empty fields are ignored.
rules.filters.minDownloadsHelp: Filter out results with fewer downloads than this value.
rules.filters.minEndorsementsHelp: Filter out results with fewer endorsements than this value.
rules.filters.minLikesHelp: Filter out results with fewer likes than this value.
rules.filters.updatedWithinDaysHelp: Keep only results updated within this many days. Leave empty to ignore update age.
rules.filters.adultPolicyHelp: Controls whether adult content is allowed in results.
rules.filters.missingMetricsPolicyHelp: Choose whether results missing downloads, endorsements, or likes can pass or should be rejected.
